description: Guided visual design. All 11 approved brand colors are independent per-role choices; all 12 existing selectable font families can be used for headings or body. Presets populate this same model.

roles.label: Sidebar
roles.note: The vertical chapter navigation beside lesson content. Open the Sidebar sample menu in narrow previews. Its text color is Automatic unless you choose one.

roles.label: Title & divider second color
roles.note: The second color of title and divider gradients, and the title split layout’s right panel.

roles.label: Title & divider headings
roles.note: Large lettering on the title slide and chapter dividers. This shared choice never changes when you paint a background.

roles.label: Subtitle & divider supporting text
roles.note: The title subtitle and copyright line, plus divider chapter labels and supporting text. Content body text has its own color.

roles.label: Content slide background
roles.note: The surface behind text boxes, video and activity slides.

roles.label: Slide headings
roles.note: Headings on content slides and cards.

roles.label: Body text
roles.note: Paragraphs and lists, independent of the heading color.

roles.label: Accent
roles.note: Decorative rules, box edges and highlights. List text keeps its own readable color.

roles.label: Buttons
roles.note: Handout and video buttons. Their text color is chosen for you.

roles.label: Chapter divider background
roles.note: Behind each chapter’s opening slide. Heading color uses Title & divider headings; chapter labels and supporting text use Subtitle & divider supporting text.

optionalRoles.label: Sidebar text
optionalRoles.note: Chapter names and links in the sidebar. Automatic picks White or Royal, whichever reads better on the sidebar color.

samples.title: Make room for your next step
samples.subtitle: A sample lesson for a confident start
boxes: Notice what matters. Pick one practical goal for the week.
Break it into steps. Make a plan you can explain to a partner.
Try one action today. Reflect on what worked and adjust.
Keep the progress going. Celebrate a useful lesson learned.
